copy.error: Could not copy logs to clipboard

logs.tips: Logs are streaming from the server

detector.title: Detectors
detector.cpuUsageInformation: CPU used in preparing input and output data to/from detection models. This value does not measure inference usage, even if using a GPU or accelerator.

recordings.title: Recordings
recordings.tips: This value represents the total storage used by the recordings in Frigate's database. Frigate does not track storage usage for all files on your disk.

shm.title: SHM (shared memory) allocation
shm.warning: The current SHM size of {{total}}MB is too small. Increase it to at least {{min_shm}}MB.

frameLifetime.title: Frame lifetime
frameLifetime.description: Each camera has {{frames}} frame slots in shared memory. At the fastest camera's frame rate, each frame is available for approximately {{lifetime}}s before being overwritten.

unused.title: Unused
unused.tips: This value may not accurately represent the free space available to Frigate if you have other files stored on your drive beyond Frigate's recordings. Frigate does not track storage usage outside of its recordings.

keyframes.title: Keyframe analysis
keyframes.ok: Keyframes every ~{{seconds}}s, good for recording and playback.
keyframes.warning: Sparse or variable keyframes (longest gap ~{{seconds}}s), likely a smart codec (H.264+/H.265+), this is not recommended.
keyframes.error: Keyframe gap (~{{seconds}}s) exceeds the recording segment length ({{segmentTime}}s). Some segments may have no keyframe, which breaks playback. Disable the smart/+ codec on the camera or shorten its keyframe interval.
keyframes.recordDisabled: Recording is disabled for this camera.

stats.shmTooLow: /dev/shm allocation ({{total}} MB) should be increased to at least {{min}} MB.

models.title: AI Models
models.description: See what is running, what is cached on disk, and where analysis needs more resources. Missing measurements are shown explicitly. CPU usage uses 100% per core.
models.sharedGpuDescription: These readings cover the whole GPU. Video decoding, object detection, and Ollama may share it; utilization cannot reliably be divided by model.

pause.detector: Waiting for object detection to catch up
pause.frames: Waiting because cameras are skipping frames
pause.transcription: Built-in transcription also owns this camera. Disable it for companion-managed cameras to avoid duplicate analysis.

scopes.process: RAM and CPU describe the process running this model, including runtime overhead. Peak RAM is a process high-water mark, not model-only memory.
scopes.shared_process: This feature shares a process with other features. Do not add its RAM or CPU to other cards from the same process.
scopes.model_allocation: GPU allocation comes from Ollama. Process RAM and CPU need a collector in its container. Timings come from completed scene-description requests.

graphs.title: Model history
graphs.description: History is collected in the background and retained locally for 24 hours. Gaps indicate missing measurements; inference time refers to the last completed run.
graphs.noSamples: No readings yet. Check the field explanation below.
graphs.waiting: The first reading is shown now. A trend appears after the next sample.
graphs.tableDescription: Newest readings first. Missing or stale readings appear as gaps, never as zero.

missing.title: Why are some readings missing?
missing.intro: Zero means a measured zero. These labels explain why a value is unavailable; missing values are never plotted as zero.

remoteCollector.label: Collector needed
remoteCollector.detail: Ollama runs in a separate container. Its model inventory API does not expose process RAM or CPU. A collector in that container is needed.

awaitingRequest.label: Waiting for a request
awaitingRequest.detail: Timing is saved after a completed scene-description request. It will appear after the updated Frigate service processes one.

awaitingRun.label: Waiting for a run
awaitingRun.detail: This measurement has not been recorded since tracking started. A model stored on disk can have no run history yet.

sharedGpu.label: Shared GPU
sharedGpu.detail: The device reports overall usage. It does not reliably split this measurement between models and video decoding.

notInstrumented.label: Tracking not added
notInstrumented.detail: This feature does not yet publish this measurement. Enabled does not prove that a model is currently loaded.

fileInventory.label: Files not mapped
fileInventory.detail: This feature’s model files have not been mapped into the inventory yet.

stale.label: Readings expired
stale.detail: The collector has not refreshed recently. Old live usage is hidden until it reconnects.

sourceOffline.label: Source unavailable
sourceOffline.detail: The model service could not be reached. This is not a zero-usage reading.

modelMissing.label: Model not found
modelMissing.detail: The configured model was not found in the model inventory.

cpuOnly.label: CPU only
cpuOnly.detail: This model does not use GPU memory.

includedInRun.label: Included in run time
includedInRun.detail: This runtime initializes its speech filter as part of the first run. A separate model-load measurement is not available.

readiness.scope: Availability is not a guarantee of transcript accuracy or recording completeness. Cached models load on demand.
readiness.stale: Camera or detector measurements are missing or stale. Check the stats source.
readiness.history: Background history is unavailable; current readings may still be usable.

server.title: Host and container resources
server.scope: CPU uses 100% per logical core. Pressure is time stalled waiting for memory. OOM counts are cumulative since boot or container start. Shared resources must not be added together.
server.unavailable: Host collector is missing or stale. Install or check the read-only Proxmox collector to measure both containers.
server.pressureWarning: Host or container memory pressure is high. Review resource use before adding more AI work.
